en:
How long has it been since the Heretical Forest was burned?
While most people continue their lives as normal, averting their eyes
from the fact that the world is headed towards inevitable destruction,
the situation of the counties of the world has changed.
jp:
異形の森の焼失からどれだけの時が過ぎただろうか。
多くの人間が滅びゆく世界から目を背け
以前と同じ生活を送る一方で、
各国の情勢は大きく変化を遂げていた。

en:
Barius, the ruler of Lothria, has been overthrown. His
commitment to the stance of an independent and neutral Lothria
was nothing but a thorn in the sides of the other nations.
When his previously concealed connection with Saimore was brought
to light by spies from other countries, he quickly lost his standing.
Many of the Elea have abandoned Lothria after its fall
and have spread across the world as refugees.
After having been persecuted for so long and losing their
homes, radical sentiment among the Elea is on the rise.
It's only a matter of time before rioting begins across all of Ylva.
jp:
ロスリアを統治していたヴァリウスは失脚した。
ロスリアの理想と独立を守ろうとするその姿勢は
他国にしてみれば邪魔でしかなかったのだ。
それまで秘匿していたサイモアとの繋がりが
他国のスパイによって明るみにされ権威を失ってしまった。
エレアの多くは堕ちたロスリアに見切りをつけ
世界中へ難民として散らばっていった。
迫害され、故郷を失い、希望も潰えた彼らの中には
過激派となる者も現れ、イルヴァ各地で
エレアによる暴動が起きようとしていた。

en:
At the same time, a war has kicked off between the
Yerles and Eulderna in South Tyris.
While their goals are unknown, their hostility
and antagonism towards Juere has also drawn them
into the fray, creating a three-way conflict.
jp:
時を同じくしてサウスティリスへイェルスが、
続いてエウダーナが侵攻を開始した。
両国の目的こそ不明であったが
これらに対してジューアが反目し、
三つ巴の戦いが幕を開けるのであった。

en:
You can't control your heart's pounding as you step
foot into the chaotic South Tyris.
A new destiny calls to you.
And a new adventure awaits.
jp:
その混沌としたサウスティリスの地を訪れたあなたは
胸の高鳴りを感じずにはいられなかった。
新たな運命が呼んでいる。
新たな冒険が今、始まる。

en:
The Elea had scattered throughout the world.
In one village, a speech was just beginning.
In the center of the crowd stands a single young Elea.
jp:
世界中に散らばったエレアたち。
その集落のひとつで演説は始まった。
人だかりの中心にいたのはまだ若い一人のエレアだった。

en: Take a look at what has become of Ylva! The people have turned their eyes from the future they know is to come, spending their days only trying to forget! We Elea know the bitter taste of sadness, anger, and despair! But they forget what they have done to us! Will we allow their treatment to go unpunished? Nay, I say! We will not!
jp: 見ろ今のイルヴァの姿を！民衆は明日から目を背け、何もかもを無かったことにして日々を過ごす有様だ！我々エレアが味わった哀しみも怒りも、絶望すらも！彼らは無かったことにしているのだ！このような仕打ちが許されるだろうか？いいや、許されるはずがない！！

en: Now is the time for action... Those of you who say our revenge will bear no fruit, I want you to think again. What we do is for the sake of the future. Already we have nothing left but pain. We must be united. Only be returning the people's consciousness and confronting this calamity can our fallen brothers and sisters rest in peace.
jp: 今こそ決起の時だ…。我々の行動を何も生み出さない復讐だと否定する者もいるだろうが、どうか今一度よく考えてほしい。これは世界の明日のためでもある。もはや痛みをもってしか、人々を事態と向き合わせることなどできはしない。人々の意識を改革し災厄に立ち向かわせることでしか、犠牲となった我らが故郷は浮かばれないのだ。

en: We will take on the role of the despised once more. But this time not by the plotting of Saimore, but of our own will! Rise, my brothers! For the sake of this world! Only we who know so much pain may open the doors to the future!
jp: 我々は再び憎まれ役となる。ただし今度はサイモアの謀略によってではなく、我々の意思によってだ！立ち上がれ同胞よ、この星の未来のために！痛みを知る我らにのみ、未来は切り開くことができるのだ！

en: Uooooooooh! For the future of our world!
jp: うおおおおおおおお！この星の未来のために！

en: It was a good speech. Well worth the effort you took to memorize the script.
jp: いい演説だったぞ。台本を必死で暗記した甲斐があったじゃないか。

en: Hmm. It's not a bald-faced lie, but saying it's for the future and for our world and all... I think it came off sounding a little too dramatic.
jp: しかし…丸っきり嘘とはいうわけじゃないが、星のため、世界のためとは大きく出たな。

en: But of course. If you openly said it was all for revenge, we wouldn't be able to gather any support outside of the Elea. We're just ordinary people. If we don't expand our forces, we won't be able to achieve anything.
jp: 当たり前だ。馬鹿正直に復讐目的だと言ってはエレア外の支援者が集まらないだろう。我々は一般人だ。勢力を拡大しなければ話にならない。

en: Mr. Halion, what should we do next?
jp: ハリオンさん、俺ら次なにすればいいっすか。

en: Ah, good timing. Go to the nearest town and gather supplies. I've written them all down in these instructions. I'm counting on you.
jp: いいところに来た。近くの街で物資を調達してきてくれ。詳しいことは全部この指示書に書いておいた。頼むぞ。

en: Yes sir.
jp: うっす。

en: Hey, Halion. I know I was just talking about expanding our forces and all, but are you sure you're okay adding those brigands to our ranks?
jp: …なぁ、ハリオン。勢力を拡大しろと言った直後でなんだが、あんな野盗やっていた連中を仲間に加えて大丈夫か？

en: Those people were persecuted, so they turned to lives of thievery. It's not like they did it because they wanted to. Once they're a part of our ranks, I'm sure they will have the same feelings that we do.
jp: あいつらだって迫害されて野盗に身をやつしていただけだ。好きでああなったわけじゃないだろう。参加してくれた以上、想いは同じはずだと俺は信じている。

en: Is that so? I hope you're right...
jp: そうなのか？だったらいいが…。

en:
The majority of the village rose to action after the speech.
Upon hearing the news, many Elea from
other villages joined the uprising, and the
power of the extremists was increasing every day.
As the extremists grew in number, order was gradually
decreasing, leading to looting and mob behavior.
The status of the Elea continued to fall...
jp:
演説のあと集落のエレアの大多数が決起した。
そしてその知らせを耳にした
他の集落のエレアたちも次々と加わり
過激派の勢力は日に日に増していった。
一方でその規律は徐々に乱れ、
ただ略奪行為を行うだけの暴徒へと
成り下がるエレアも増えていくのだった…。

Any last words, albino Prince of Zanan?
...Yes. I must tell you something.
Prior to destroying the Forest... I felt that I could be satisfied by leaving a scar upon Ylva. And yet somehow the reality has turned out like this.

A certain Elean girl left a spark of light in my heart... And after leaving Zanan to live normally while hiding my identity, I became burdened by an ever increasing sense of guilt. But I chose to live with this guilt, even if it meant drinking the dirtest sludge.
You damned fool... who are you to say how guilty you feel! You know it's too late. They're not coming back...
...I'm truly sorry. I don't expect you to forgive me after all I've done. But the real issue is this.

Once again I set out to investigate the Meshera. Perhaps I wished to atone for my sins. Regardless, I made a discovery and cannot allow myself to die before entrusting another with this information. There is an ancient ruin in South Tyris... That Is where the Meshera were born. Ylva's hope lies within its deepest reaches.
Enough! Hmph, I'm amazed that you'd continue to spout lies even as you head towards your grave. Did you honestly think that anyone here would believe your story?!

Sorry about that. Just doing my job. And I'll use force to take that man as well if I need to.

jp: 無理はするな、お前に死なれたら我々は総崩れだ。

jp: あいつは最初は干からびた石のようになっていたんだ。しかし、兵士を次々に飲み込んで膨張し、あっという間に…フロア全体が奴の菌糸で覆われてしまった…。

jp: エルマナ！？おい、返事しろよ…うっ、ちくしょう…。お、俺も沈んでいく…身体が溶かされ…て…ああっ…あたたか…い…。

en: Communication has been lost...

en: Oh my god...
jp: なんてことなの…。

en: Surely there must have been a research facility with materials and samples? But I bet that an accident of some sort ended up creating a monster, so it was sealed up to protect the exterior, not the interior.
jp: 研究施設があって、資料やサンプルがあるのは間違いないんじゃない？ただ、何かしらの事故で怪物が生まれてしまって、内側ではなく外側を守るために封印されていたのよきっと。

en: If what you're saying is true, then this monster somehow survived all the way from the time of the previous civilization? What a tremendous life force.

en: Gahahahahahha! I can't tell the difference between a doctor and a chief developer!
jp: カッカッカ！博士とか開発主任とか言われても、わしには違いがピンとこんな！

en: That's why you're such a goddamned guy. I don't know what's so great about mechas anyway. I'm more interested in the relics in those ruins.
jp: まったく、これだから男どもは。メカの何がいいのかねぇ。私は遺跡のお宝のほうが気になるよ。

en: Why don't you try and treat things that aren't relics with a little more respect. And please, don't destroy the treasured relics of Rehm-ido.
jp: お前は宝以外をもうちょっと丁重に扱え。頼むからレミードの貴重な遺物は破壊しないでくれよ。

en: I agree with you on that. Even for adventurer standard, Miss Hermana is too rough.
jp: それについてはわしも同感じゃ。いくら冒険者といえど、エルマナ殿は手荒すぎるからの。

en: Don't worry. After this mission, I'll be officially hired by Yelles. He said he'll be careful not to affect his grade!
jp: 面倒くさがって宝箱を中身ごと砕いちゃう爺さんには言われたくないねぇ…。

en: Anyway! I'll be officially employed by Yerles. I'll be careful not to ruin my reputation before then!
jp: とにかく！この任務が終わったら正式にイェルスに雇ってもらえるんだ。評定に響かないよう気をつけるって！

en: I hope so. Oh, yeah, another adventurer is supposed to join us later. He's a pretty good fighter, you know. You might want to finish your investigation before he takes all the credit.
jp: ならいいがな。ああそうそう、後からもう一人冒険者が合流する手筈になっている。かなりのツワモノだからな。手柄を取られないうちに調査を済ませたほうがいいかもしれないぞ。

en: All right, I'll be on the lookout for him. Well, I'll be off then, doc.
jp: なってこった、そりゃ張り切らないとな！じゃあ行ってくるよ博士。

en: Gah...aah...
jp: ぐ…ああ…。

en: Hey, doc. What the hell happened to my body? A machine or something will fix me, right...?
jp: なぁ博士ぇ…俺の身体はどうなっちまったんだよ…。機械で、機械で直してくれるよなぁ…？

en: What a slimy, mangled mess...
jp: どろどろで、ぐちゃぐちゃで…ひ、ひひひひひひっ！

en: If only you had prepared better equipment, we wouldn't all be dead.... The guns and armor you prepared were no match for that monster...
jp: あんたがもっといい武装を用意していれば、みんな死なずに済んだんだ…。あんたの用意した銃も装甲も、あの化け物には通用しなかった…。

en: I'm sorry... I will avenge you. With this mech I've created, I promise...
jp: すまない…。仇は討つ。俺の作ったメカで、絶対に…。

en: ...Wha!? Must have been a bad dream. ...Damn.
jp: …はっ！？嫌な夢を見てしまったな。…くそっ。

en: This is it. The mission, and my revenge... I'll take it all into my own hands.)
jp: （やってやろうじゃないか。使命も、仇討ちも、俺なりのやり方でな）

en: <Liana> The Girl of Fancies
<Larnneire> The Listener of the Wind
<Lomias> The Messenger From Vindale
<Bethel> The White Hawk
Special Forces Commander <Milis>
...Then I'll give you a simple rundown of the plan.

The target of this operation is the Plant. Since it's an obstacle to our investigation into the deepest areas of the ruin, we'll exterminate it. As we've learned from the data we have, the Plant attacks by spreading spores onto its targets without even moving from its spot, and manipulates those it has absorbed.

Therefore the difficult to absorb mechanized units will take the front, and an optical barrier will be deployed for defense. Our soldiers will be firing an unending barrage of ether bullets from the rear. This is certain to cause some damage to the monster.

Upon confirmation that the Plant has ceased action in order to revive itself, the mechanized units will fall back and the Yerleswood Mk2 will advance. After completely destroying the Plant through the Ether Blaster in the Yerleswood's chest, the entire bottom floor will be sterilized via Ether. This will conclude the operation.
I see. So what are you expecting from us then?

We'd like for you all to take action with our 7th Special Forces team. Your two Elean companions will be in charge of carrying the Ether we'll use for sterilization, while the remaining two will be in the rear guard.
We agreed to cooperate with your study on the nullification of the Meshera the other day. We'd be glad to cooperate in this strategy as well.
I don't mind cooperating, but... You want us to carry the Ether since Elea are more resistant to its corruption, right? Being an Elea is rough.

We wanted to use the right people for the right tasks. We're presently making the final adjustments to our equipment that we need for this operation. Once these adjustments are finished we'll be departing, so be ready to leave at any time.
<Liana> The Girl of Fancies

en:
As you finish up your brief investigation of Rehmido's
lowest level and prepare to head back to the surface,
the Yerles army and Larnneire's party descend the stairs
to the lowest level.
jp:
あなたが最深部の簡単な調査を終え、
一度上へ戻ろうとしたまさにその時、
イェルス軍とラーネイレの一行が最深部へ突入してきた。

en: W-what is this...? We rushed because the reaction mysteriously disappeared. Has the plant already been destroyed?
jp: な、なんだこれは…。反応が消えたのを不審に思い突入してみれば、すでにムドが撃破された後だと？

en: Is that an adventurer over there? Most likely they're the one that took it down.
jp: あそこに立っているのは冒険者か。どうやら奴が倒したようだな。

en: Absolutely ridiculous... How could an adventurer even make it here?! If I wasn't seeing it myself I wouldn't believe it!
jp: 冒険者にはとんでもないのもいるって聞いてたけれど…まさかここまでなんて！いざ目にすると信じられないわね。

en: Hold on a minute. Lomias... Haven't we seen that adventurer before?
jp: ちょっと待って。ロミアス、あの冒険者…見覚えはない？

en: Come on, you've got to be joking! I've never seen a monster like that before.
jp: おいおい、冗談だろう！あんな化け物、私は知らないぞ。

en: Perhaps I'm mistaken. Excuse me, but have we met...Oh! That charm! Lomias, that's the charm you handed over to the adventurer we nursed back to health in that cave!
jp: そんなはずはないわ。すみません、以前どこかでお会いしまし…その古びたお守りは！…あの日洞窟で冒険者を介抱したときに渡したものだわ。

en: I see, so it's you then...! I'm glad to see you again.
jp: そう、あなただったのね…！また会えて嬉しいわ。

en:
- Epilogue -
<The world continues to turn>
jp:
- エピローグ -
《紡ぎ出された未来》

en:
You hid the fact that you possessed the Origin of Vice
from Larnneire's entourage and the Yerles army.
Initially they were wary of your uncanny familiarity
with the technology of the ancient civilizations.
jp:
ラーネイレの一行とイェルス軍に対して
あなたは常闇の眼の所持者であることを隠し接触した。
旧文明の技術に精通しているあなたのことを
面々は当初警戒していたようだ。

en:
But recognizing you as an accomplished adventurer,
they eventually dropped their suspicions. Through the combined
power of your knowledge, the science of the Yerles,
and the remaining data from the bottom of Remido, the
study of the Meshera advanced at a remarkable pace.
jp:
だがあなたが冒険者であるということもあり
それ以上は不審に思われることもなく受け入れられた。
あなたの持つ知識、イェルスの科学力、
そして最下層に残されていたサンプルとデータにより
メシェーラの研究は飛躍的に進んでいくのであった。

en:
Beaten to the punch by the Yerles, the Eulderna
military withdrew from Juere's territory.
The three-sided war came to a close. South Tyris
changed from a place mired in the chaos of a fullscale
war to an area that rarely even saw skirmishes.
jp:
イェルスに先を越された
エウダーナ軍はジューア領から撤退。
こうして三つ巴の戦いは終結した。
あれほど戦火で混沌としていたサウスティリスの地も
いつしか稀に小競り合いが見られる程度となった。

en: - Three Years Later -
jp: - 三年後 -

en:
An artificial bacteria which got out of control
and became far more harmful than before...
That was the true nature of the Meshera.
Together with the scientists of Yerles, you
were able to revive the original Meshera strain,
raise its tolerance to mutating out of control,
and incorporate the ability to destroy the Meshera.
jp:
レム・イドにおいて開発中だった人工細菌が
災害の影響で暴走し有害化したもの…
それがメシェーラの正体だった。
メシェーラへ変質する以前の
無害な細菌を復元したあなたは
暴走しないよう安定性を高めるとともに
メシェーラの駆逐能力をも組み込むことに成功した。

en:
After many tests to verify its safety and potency,
this new artificial bacteria was unleashed on the world.
Though it will take an extraordinary amount of time for
the Meshera to be eliminated from Ylva, it is certain
that as its hold weakens that the Ether Winds too
will become less potent.
jp:
幾度にも渡る安全性の実験と確認を済ませたのち
改良された細菌は世界に放たれた。
メシェーラがイルヴァから完全に駆逐されるには
途方もない年月がかかるだろうが、
確実に汚染は減り免疫機能であるエーテルの放出も
逓減していくことだろう。

en:
Having declined the Yerles' attempt at scouting you and
leaving Melugas, you parted from Larnneire who left to
revive Vindale and began a new adventure.
You believe that now, at some point in the future,
that the threat of the Meshera will disappear from Ylva...
jp:
イェルス軍のスカウトを断りメルガスを後にしたあなたは、
復興のためにヴィンデールへ向かうラーネイレたちと別れ、
再び冒険の旅へと出発した。
いつか、この世界から完全に
メシェーラの脅威が消え去る日を信じて…。

 <Chapter 2 END>

en:
The fatigue from your journey seems to
have gotten the best of you, and you slowly fall
asleep while being rocked around with the
cargo on a merchant's wagon heading towards
Lumiest. Some time later, you are awoken
from your slumber by the sounds of the
guards. The wagon is stopped for a break.
jp:
ルミエストに向かう商隊の荷馬車の中で
あなたは人の話し声に気付いて目を覚ました。
貨物と共に揺られているうちに、旅の疲れもあってか
いつの間にか眠り込んでいたらしい。
休憩中なのか、荷馬車は動きを止めていた。

en:
Still not fully awakened from your dreams, you listen to
the conversation between the familiar voices.
jp:
まだ夢より覚めきらないあなたは
朦朧とする意識の中、どこか聞き覚えのある
旅人たちの話し声に耳を傾けていた。

en: ...Really? I don't know anything myself, but this is what I've heard from other mercenaries...
jp: …そうなのか？これは傭兵仲間から聞いた話で俺様もよくは知らないんだが…。

en: It was about a month ago, I think. Heard it from one of the mercs that were hired by Kikkas for their fight with Nieca.
jp: ひと月ほど前のことらしい。キッカスの軍隊に雇われたそいつは、ニーサとの小競り合いに駆り出されていたんだ。

en: Kikkas, huh.
jp: キッカスでも、か。

en: ...? Anyways, it happened one night when he was on guard duty.
jp: …？まぁいい。そいつが夜の見張りをしていた時だ。

en: He got a strange feeling all of a sudden, and when he looked towards the enemy camp, he saw a dazzling pillar of light stretching towards the sky. Thinking it must be some type of attack magic - a new weapon or something - he went and woke up the rest of the camp. He...
jp: ふと妙な気配を感じて敵陣のほうを見た瞬間、そこから眩い光の柱が空に向かって伸びていったらしい。敵軍の魔法か新兵器かなにかかと思って、そいつはすぐに味方を叩き起こしに行ったんだ…

en:
Just then, the break ended and the wagon began
to move again. The two men's conversation continued,
but their voices slowly faded until you could no
longer hear them.
jp:
休憩が終わったのか、不意に荷馬車が動き出した。
旅人たちの会話は依然として続いていたようだが
すぐに遠のき、聞こえなくなった。

en:
You intended to hop off the wagon just past the border,
but you can't hold out against your sleepiness any longer.
You slowly fell into a deep slumber once more...
jp:
関所を出たところで荷馬車から
降りる予定だったのだが眠気には勝てず、
あなたの意識は再び闇へと落ちていくのだった…。

en:
- At the same time, in the sky above Eulderna. -
"It" was enshrined in the sky, its
shadow covering half of the country.
jp:
同刻 - エウダーナ 上空 -
未開の地からエウダーナ領土の半分を覆うかのように
「それ」は上空に鎮座していた。

en:
When, where, or how it came to be there, none who
saw it knows. Its greatness was such that even the
great magic of Eulderna could not have concealed it.
This new information spread throughout the world like
wildfire.
jp:
いつ、どこからどのように現れたのか
目撃した者は誰一人としていなかった。
そしてその巨大さは魔術に秀でたエウダーナといえども
秘匿しきれるものではなく、
情報は瞬く間に世界中へ広がっていった──

en: In the throne room of Palmia.

en: As of yesterday, 568 people have gone missing. Soldiers, adventurers, and merchants seem to make up the bulk of them. From the information we've gathered, the situation is the same in the other countries of the world.
jp: 国内における行方不明者は昨日までの時点で568名。その多くは冒険者や傭兵、行商人など各地を渡り歩いている者が占めております。雇った者たちの調査報告によると、国外でも同様の事件が多発している模様です。

en: That's it...? This is all you've figured out, despite all the investigators and adventurers you've hired
jp: それだけか…？多くの情報屋と冒険者を雇って調べさせている割には情報が少なすぎるのではないのか。

en: W-well...
jp: そ、それが…。

en: I've lost contact with the majority of the people I hired for the investigation... The Puppeteer, the Silver Bear of Mayroon, the Dragon Hunter, the White Hawk... All communications with them have stopped. Even the Informers they used as contacts don't know what's going on.
jp: 調査のために雇った者たちの多くもまた、次々に行方がわからなくなっています…。人形使い、メイルーンの銀熊、竜の狩人、白き鷹…いずれも定期連絡がなく、情報屋でも消息のわからない状態です。

en: How? Aren't they supposed to be the best of the best? Is our investigation being purposely obstructed by someone, or is this mere chance? In any case, we must find replacements for them quickly... Speaking of which, one of my subordinates mentioned seeing that adventurer that helped with the investigation of Lesimas on the outskirts of town. If we can get that adventurer to help us, then maybe...
jp: なんと、いずれも猛者ばかりではないか。何者かによる調査の妨害か、それともただの偶然であるのか。いずれにしても早急に代わりの者を用意せねばなるまい。…そういえば部下の一人が、レシマスの調査に貢献した冒険者を郊外で見かけたと言っておったな。奴ならばあるいは…。

en: You've done well, Erystia. Hire the adventurer that the Major General speaks of and continue your investigation into the source of these incidents.
jp: ご苦労でしたエリステア。コネリー少将の言っている冒険者を雇って調査を続け、この異変の全容を明らかにするのです。

en: Yes Your Majesty.
jp: はい、スターシャ様。

en: (I must protect the country that he loved. No matter what it takes...)
jp: （あの人が愛したこの国を、何としても異変から守らなければ。そう、何としても…）

en:
The day came to a close, and dusk quickly approached.
Without warning, you are suddenly awaked from your rest
upon the research vessel Aurora that is headed for Mayroon.
You can hear a mysterious voice that seems to be
coming from the sky.
You rush to the deck only to find the sailors in
a daze, also listening to the mysterious voice from the
sky.
jp:
日が落ち、辺りが薄闇に閉ざされて間もなくの頃だった。
メイルーンに向かう探査船アウロラの
客室で休息を取っていたあなたは
突然、夜空の彼方から響く謎の声に起こされた。
甲板に飛び出し辺りを見回すと、
船員たちにもその謎の声は聞こえているらしく
誰もが呆然と耳を傾けているようであった。

en: I am Tezcatlipoca, the herald of your destruction... Sierra Terre will end, and Chaos shall reign. The stage has been set. If you wish to prevent that which started with Nefia... Then bring yourselves to The Eternal Seal in the depths of the Cradle of Chaos and show me your power.
jp: 我が名はテスカトリポカ。今を生きる定命のお前たちに真なる終末を告げる者だ。…シエラ・テールはじきに滅び、やがて混沌へと回帰するであろう。舞台は整った。止めたくば始まりのネフィア…混沌の巨城地下に広がる神の間へと辿り着き、我に力を示せ。

en:
One of the sailors screams. A pillar of light descends
from the sky, engulfing your body as your consciousness
fades.
jp:
…そして、船員のひとりが悲鳴をあげた。
天から虹色の光があなたへと一直線に降り注ぎ
あなたの身体と意識は光の奔流にのまれていった。

en: Chief Developer <Dr. Gavela>
<Heinrich> The Iron Carnel

General, we've just confirmed the ability of the Melugast to break through the barrier. The experiment is a success.

I would have never doubted you. But wasn't this experiment set for two weeks from now? You rushed through it, didn't you? It's unusual for you to not run more thorough tests. I thought you were more careful than this.
There were no need for additional adjustments. Besides, isn't a real-world test better than a rehearsed performance?
Umm... Why are you referring to it as "Melugast"? I thought its name was the D-3...
Oh don't be so formal, Milis. "D-3" doesn't roll off the tongue well, so Melugast is the nickname I gave it. A "gust" of wind from Melugas. How's that?
...A predictable naming scheme, as usual.
(But the remote control operation doesn't work properly within the barrier. I want to adjust the autonomy circuit a bit more... Will it be capable of bringing "them" back...?)
<Liana> The Girl of Fancies

en: Lomias, take that sapling please.
jp: ロミアス、そっちの苗を取ってちょうだい。

en: Sure... But man, talk about having to be patient. How many years is it going to take for these saplings to grow and the Forest to return?
jp: ああ。…しかし気の長い話だな。この苗たちが大木に成長し森が元の規模に戻るには何年かかることやら。

en: It's the only option we have. If the Forest returns, everyone who left should come back too.
jp: 気長にやるしかないわ。森が元の姿に戻れば、各国に散らばったみんなも戻ってくるはずよ。

en: I know that, but why are we the ones that have to replant everything? I think it'd be best if the ones who burnt the Forest in the first place took responsibility and... Hmm?
jp: それはわかるが、苗植えなんかを何故私がやらなくてはいけないんだ。森を焼いた連中に責任を持ってやらせたいぐらいなんだが…ん？

en: U-ugh... Larnneire... Lomias...
jp: うう…ラーネイレぇ、ロミアスぅ…。

en: Liana?! What's wrong?! Wasn't Bethel with you?
jp: リアナ！？ど、どうしたの、ヴェセルは一緒じゃないの？

en: !! ...Bethel... Bethel is...! Bethel isn't coming back...! His contacts... They say he might have been caught up in the strange disappearances that have been happening... How could this happen... My precious Bethel is gone! Uugh... My poor Bethel...!!
jp: ！！…ヴェセル。ヴェセルがっ！ヴェセルが帰ってこないの！情報屋たちに訊いても最近起きてる失踪事件に巻き込まれたんじゃないかって言うし、ヴェセル…こんなのって…。あたしがいないとヴェセルはっ！ううっ…可哀想なヴェセルぅうう…！！

en: How... Even Bethel? ...Don't worry, Liana. We'll look for Bethel together.
jp: そんな…ヴェセルが？…わかったわリアナ、私たちも一緒にヴェセルを探すわ。
（私たち…？）

en: <Orphe> The Apostle of Chaos
jp: 混沌の使徒『オルフェ』

en: <Alfred> the Cangnan Wind of Lothria
jp: ロスリアの蒼風『アルフレド』

en: <Minea> The Puppeteer
jp: 人形使い『ミネア』

en: Master Orphe. The release of the Servant appears to be complete.
jp: オルフェ様。眷属の解放が終わったようです。

en: Hoh... This is surprising. The power of a mere mortal truly can remove the shackles woven by the gods themselves.
jp: ほう…これは驚いた。定命ごときが本当に神のかけた枷を外せるとは。

en: Not just that. Soon the power will be enough to affect even the surface.
jp: いえいえ、それだけではありません。すぐにでも下界で力を振るうことができる状態です。

en: It is... connected even outside this castle? I see... I will believe your claim that it has the power to connect to Aion. We should keep sending the Servants into the world as a demonstration of our power.
jp: これは…城の外に繋がっている？なるほど、超越者たち…アイオンに通じる力を持っているという言葉、信じてやろう。そのまま眷属を下界へと送り込み、我々の力を見せつけるといい。

en: As you wish. We will continue to free the remaining Servants as we make our way to The Eternal Seal, staining the world with Chaos.
jp: お任せを。神の間までの道中に捕らえられている残りの眷属たちも順次解放し、世界を混沌に染め上げましょう。

en: Even without your secret arts. Our Great Lord will awaken sooner or later. But the gods and adventurers of Ylva... It's likely they will try to intervene. It's good that we throw as many obstacles at them as we can. Until the Great Lord awakens, you must catch anyone who would intrude upon this castle, and if feasible, make them your puppets like that man.
jp: お前の秘術などなくとも、遅かれ早かれ我々の大いなる神は目覚める。だが現在のイルヴァの神々や冒険者…イレギュラーの妨害も有り得る、手駒が多いに越したことはないだろう。目覚めまでの間、お前たちはこの城へやってきた者たちを捕え、可能ならばあの男のように操り人形としてしまえ。

en: Fufu. My dolls will increase even further...
jp: ふふ。またお人形さんが増えるのですね…。

en: Don't worry. Even if I have to replace this body, I will protect the sleeping God of Chaos.
jp: ご安心を。この身に代えても、眠りに就いている混沌の神を守り抜いてみせますよ。

en: Good... You should be pleased. Though you may just be another foolish mortal, you still might be one of the wisest among them.
jp: そうだな…喜ぶといい。定命という愚かな存在であるが、お前たちはその中でもまだ聡明と言えるだろう。

en: (Heh. Which one of us is really the stupid one here...?)
jp: （さて。本当に愚かなのはどちらでしょうね…？）

en: <Halion> The Extremist
Elea Extremist

- Karune, the location of the original Forest -
Once having been encroached upon by the Vinal Forest,
the forest of Karune become inhospitable to humans.
Though the Forest was burned by Zanan, the people of
Karune had never returned to its location.

These are the remnants of the radical Elean group
that began a massive riot years ago. At first they
wanted to revive their home... In Vindale, they would
once again rise in rebellion. But having been refused
by the moderated that hated the trouble, and would not
come back to the home, they now live in Karune, gazing
at the distant land of their birth.
Are you really leaving?
Yes.

There's not even a hundred of us left anymore. If we can't even reach a consensus to return to our homeland, there's no way we'll be able to recover. But still, I can see the will to fight in your eyes.

Even though we were active on so large of a scale, the world still treats the persecution of the Elea as something of the past. Yet even now the Elea are still considered dangerous. I can't allow such an absurdity.

I think I will write a book. There are other Elea living in small villages around the world just like us. I will go and listen to their stories of persecution, and see how they are now treated with my own eyes. The truth will be written down for all in the future to see. That is the way I can have my revenge.

I'm scared. For every day that passes, my grudge against those who persecuted us and my anger about it is fading. Even though all the suffering I went through, even though I felt so strongly I couldn't permit it... I think now that forgetting everything and living quietly in this land may be happiness.
There's nothing wrong with that... It's almost time for me to leave. I hope that all of you may continue to live peacefully. If fate wills it, we will meet again.
<Halion> The Extremist
jp: 過激派の『ハリオン』

en: - Niesa's Southern shore -
jp: - ニーサ 南端沿岸部 -

en: Hahahaha... Dammit all...! Niesa was in sight, but the ship just had to get attacked and destroyed by a sea monster. It's good that I survived and drifted here, but now I'm completely lost... There must be some sort of clue as to where I am...
jp: はぁはぁ…。くそっ…！ニーサ目前で船が海洋生物に襲われ大破するとは。生きて流れ着いたのはいいが、自分がどのあたりにいるのかさっぱりだ…。なにか、手がかりになりそうなものは…。

en: What is that?
jp: なんだこれは？

en: (The machine in the center... The parts look brand new. Definitely not something made by an ancient civilization. Must be from the Yerles. But with the number of suspicious-looking "things" connected to it, it looks like an ancient magical device. There are even some magical circles drawn around it. What the hell is this? And why here?)
jp: （中央に配置されている機械は…部品が真新しいな。古代機械などではなく、おそらくイェルス製だろう。だが機械に接続されている怪しげな物の数々は、古めかしい魔道具のようだ。さらに周囲には幾つも魔方陣が描かれている。いったい、誰がこんなものを？なぜここに？）

en: ...Thinking about it isn't going to help me. I think it would be dangerous to approach it carelessly, but I should hurry.
jp: …考えてもわからないな。迂闊に近づくのも危険そうだ、先を急ぐとしよう。

en: Hey, hey... What is this light?
jp: おい。おい…ちょっと待て。なんだこの光は。

en: <Halion> The Extremist
jp: 過激派の『ハリオン』

en: <Inqtual> The Demon of Vengeance
jp: 復讐の悪魔『インクツァル』

en: Ugh, my eyes sting... What on earth just happened? Did that machine just activate...?
jp: うう、目がチカチカする。一体何が起きた？あの装置が起動したのか…？

en: This is... outside the castle. Hmph... Despite being freed from the gods' shackles, his stolen power doesn't seem to have returned.
jp: ここは…城の外か。ふん…神の枷から解放されても、奪われた力は戻ってこないようだな。

en: What is that? I can't see very well. Who the hell is over there?
jp: なんだ？よく見えない。そこにいるのは一体誰だ。

en: I am Inqtual. I love desire for vengeance.
jp: ワタシはインクツァル。強い復讐心を好む悪魔。

en: Oooh... This little one's desire for vengeance is quite appetizing indeed. Form a contract with me and I will help you. You don't have even a speck of the power needed for your revenge... How about it? Don't you desire power?
jp: おお…矮小な器に抑圧されたその復讐心、実に美味そうだ。ワタシと契約すれば、お前に協力してやろう。見れば復讐を果たせるだけの力を微塵も持ち合わせていないようだ…どうだ？力が欲しいだろう？

en: A demon of vengeance. I see. It's true that I am weak. I had to change my method of revenge because I didn't have power...
jp: なるほど、復讐の悪魔か。確かに俺には力がない。力がないからこそ、復讐の方法を変えなければならなかった…。

en: But don't you dare look down on me. Be you god or devil, I don't want your power. The revenge of the Elea will only have meaning if it comes from their own power... Besides, I heard you say "appetizing". You literally feed upon people's desire for revenge. I'm not going to be used like that.
jp: だが、見くびるなよ。たとえ神だろうが悪魔だろうが、お前の力を借りるつもりはない。エレアの復讐はエレアの力で果たしてこそ意味があるのだ。…それに、美味そうと言ったな。人の復讐心を文字通り食い物にしようなどという、下種な企みが通用すると思うな。

en: Are you sure that's what you want? Your revenge won't succeed if you turn me down. Your chance for revenge will never come.
jp: そんなことを言っていいのか？この誘いを断れば、お前の復讐は成功しない。復讐できる機会は永遠に来ないだろう。

en: ...You talk too much! Get out of here, demon!
jp: …くどい！消えろ、悪魔め！

en: Very well. I thought I had found a pawn, and yet... a mere mortal denies me. Then to recover my power, even if slightly, I will feast on his desire for vengeance.
jp: いいだろう。契約すればいい手駒になると思ったが…定命の分際で拒むか。ならば力を少しでも取り戻すため、糧として食らいつくしてやろう。

en: Wh... S-sure didn't take you long to resort to force, did it?
jp: な…いいきなり実力行使とは、ず随分と余裕のないい奴だな。

en: I warned you. I said if you turned me down that your revenge wouldn't succeed. Now then... I wonder what your soul will taste like.
jp: しっかりと警告はしておいたはずだ。誘いを断れば、「お前の復讐は成功しない。復讐できる機会は永遠に来ないだろう」と。さて…お前の心はどのような味がするのかな？

en: S-shouldn't have expected anything else from a devil... Don't come near me. Hey! Leave me alone!
jp: さ、さすがは悪魔だ、趣味が悪い…近寄るな。おい！近寄るな！

en: U-uwaaaaaaah!
jp: う、うわああああああ！

jp: 混沌の使徒『オルフェ』

en: <Alfred> the Cangnan Wind of Lothria
jp: ロスリアの蒼風『アルフレド』

jp: 人形使い『ミネア』

en: Archmage
jp: 上級魔道士

jp: エウダーナ市民

en: <Marka> The Silver Bear of Mayroon
jp: メイルーンの銀熊『マルカ』

jp: 開発主任『ガベラ』

en: <Heinrich> The Iron Carnel
jp: 機甲将軍『アインリッヒ』

en: Security Officer <Orville>
jp: 警備部隊長『オービル』

en: - At the Eulderna Castle Town -
jp: - エウダーナ王都 -

en: I never would have thought I'd be stuck clinging to the side of a magic ship because there was no room with the cargo. My hands are still numb... Oh? The main street is awfully noisy.
jp: まさか貨物室に隠れるスペースが無くて、魔導船の外壁にしがみつくことになるとは思わなかったなぁ。まだ手が痺れてるや。…おや？大通りの方がずいぶん騒がしいじゃないか。

en: It's no good. T-there's too many of them. Any more and we'll...!
jp: 駄目です。か、数が多すぎる。これ以上は…！

en: What? Even an archmage can't handle it? Someone contact the royal palace. We need the royal magicians!
jp: 何ということだ、上級魔道士様でも太刀打ちできないのか。誰か王宮に連絡を。王宮魔道士様たちを呼んでくるんだ！

en: The Chaos Spirits are acting violently? I'll head to the port then and take advantage of the uproar.
jp: カオス・スピリットの群れが暴れているのか。あのくらいならどうにかなるだろうし、この騒ぎに乗じて港を目指そう。

en: - Melugas -
jp: - メルガス -

en: General, the enemy is receiving reinforcements from the sky! Eek! Their numbers are incredible!
jp: 将軍、空から敵の増援が！ひぃぃっ、すごい数だ。

en: Don't let them into close range. Guards, what are you doing?! Begin the artillery barrage!
jp: 敵を近づけさせるな。警備隊、弾幕薄いぞ！何をやっている！

en: General, it's me, Gavela. We'll drive away the reinforcements with this, but we're counting on you to help with the remaining ground forces.
jp: 将軍、こちらガベラだ。増援はこちらで駆逐する。地上の残存勢力の処理を頼む。

en: Open the central gate. Raise the catapult. Neo Yerleswood, fire!
jp: 中央ゲート開放。カタパルト上昇。ネオ・イェルスード、射出！

en: The Servants of Chaos we've released are wrecking havoc all over the world. The entire world is falling into Chaos, and the heads of each nation are lost, not knowing how to react.
jp: 眷属たちを解放した広間から混沌の精霊たちを送り込み、世界中を攻撃させています。今頃は各地で混乱が起き、権力者どもは何もできず狼狽えていることでしょう。

en: ! Wait. Master Orphe, someone seems to be coming to the hall. I'm certain of it. I'll have my doll prepare for combat.
jp: ！待ちなさい。オルフェ様、その広間に何者かがやってきたようです。間違いありません。私の操っているお人形が戦闘態勢に入っています。

en: Do not panic, Puppeteer. A barrier has been erected with the power taken from the King. They won't be able to enter the lower levels. Even without it, there's nobody who could fight through the number of our forces there.
jp: そう慌てるな人形使い。王から引き継いだ力で結界を張ってある。下層に降りてくることは不可能だ。そうでなくともあの数の混沌の軍勢相手に渡り合える者などそうはいないだろう。

en: What power... I would have never expected less, Master Orphe.
jp: さすがはオルフェ様…そのような力をお持ちとは。

en: You should have told us sooner, Master Orphe...
jp: いやはや、私たちに黙っているなんてオルフェ様も人が悪い…。

en: (I wasn't expecting this, but it's convenient. This should grant us a little time.)
jp: （想定外ですがむしろ都合がいい。しばらく時間を稼いでもらいましょうか）

en: <Stersha> The Queen of Palmia
jp: パルミア王妃『スターシャ』

en: <Conerly> The Major General of Palmia
jp: パルミア少将『コネリー』

en: <Erystia> The Scholar of History
jp: 歴史を学ぶ『エリステア』

en: - In the castle in Palmia -
jp: - パルミア城 一室 -

en: All of the testimonies we've received are almost identical. There's still a lot that I don't understand though. Who is the one that summoned them to Lost Ylva in the first place? Some of the people mention hearing the voice of "Tezcatlipoca", the God that is said to have gone on a rampage and started the War of the Gods. Even if we assume that it is Tezcatlipoca that's doing the summoning, what purpose is there behind it...?
jp: 帰還した人々の証言はほぼ一致している。でもまだわからないことが山ほどあるわ。そもそも彼らをロストイルヴァへ召喚したのは一体誰？一部の冒険者は召喚される際にテスカトリポカという者の声を聞いているけれど、このテスカトリポカというのはかつて神々の大戦を引き起こし、暴れ回った神らしいという報告もあるわ。召喚者が本当にテスカトリポカなのか、もしそうだとすれば何の目的で召喚しているのか…。

en: And the power of Chaos.... The demons that have begun to run rampant through each country appear to be related. Is this resurgence of Chaos what Tezcatlipoca meant when he mentioned the end of Sierra Terre? I wonder if everything really will become clear when someone reaches The Eternal Seal...
jp: そして、混沌の勢力…最近になって各国で暴れている魔物たちが関係しているらしいけれど。これはテスカトリポカの言う「混沌への回帰」の前兆？神の間というところに到達すれば全て明らかになるのかしら…。

en: Regardless, the report about "the library of the gods" is quite interesting. There must be annals of history there written from the perspective of the gods. Ahhh, I really wish I could go there...
jp: それにしても、報告にあった「神々の図書館」は興味深いわ。蔵書の中には神々の視点から見た歴史が記されたものもあるのでしょうね。ああ、行ってみたい…。

en: Erystia! Erystia, are you here?!
jp: エリステア！エリステアはいるか！

en: What is it, Major General? I thought you and Queen Stersha were having an important meeting. I didn't expect you back so soon.
jp: 少将、どうかなされましたか？スターシャ様と重要な会談に出かけていたと思うのですが、帰ってきていたのですね。

en: That conversation is what this is all about. Queen Stersha has summoned you.
jp: その件で色々とあってな。スターシャ様がお呼びだ。

en: - In the throne room in Palmia -
jp: - パルミア 王の間 -

en: The nations of Ylva are forming an alliance...? Y-you mean even the warring states of Niesa and Kikkasu, and Eulderna and Yerles?
jp: イルヴァの全ての国家が同盟を結んだ…？そ、それは戦争中であるキッカスとニーサ、イェルスとエウダーナもでしょうか？

en: Yes. Both Mayroon and Vindale, despite avoiding the other nations, will be joining as well. Despite Juere not having a head of state, several influential people were here to represent them too.
jp: そうですよエリステア。他国との関わりを極力避けていたメイルーンやヴィンデールもです。元首が存在しないジューアも有力者数人が代表として参加しました。

en: Erystia, your suspicions are understandable. I'm still surprised myself. There hasn't been a state of peace between all of these nations in a very long time.
jp: エリステア、おぬしが訝しむのも無理はない。わしも未だに驚いておる。国家間で争っている場合でないというのは前々からわかっておったのだが。

en: ...I understand. Given the demons rampaging about each nation, and hearing that Sierra Terre is coming to an end, an alliance to settle these issues is understandable. Despite that, even the prideful Eulderna...
jp: …なるほど。世界各国で猛威を振るっている魔物や告げられたシエラ・テールの滅びに対して、同盟を組んで解決するといったところでしょうか。しかしあのプライドの高いエウダーナが…。

en: Significantly more demons have been attacking Eulderna than have been attacking here in Palmia. Their famous wizards have been falling one after the other. Powerful demons have also appeared in Kikkasu, Niesa, and Mayroon. Many of their towns have already been destroyed. Everyone is aware of this crisis. Given the small amount of damage Palmia has received, the other nations are requesting any help we can give.
jp: エウダーナにはパルミアとは桁違いの数の魔物が出没しており、高名な魔術士が次々に戦死しているらしい。ニーサ、キッカス、メイルーンには強大な悪魔が現れ、既に辺境の街がいくつか滅ぼされているという話もあった。他国もかなり危機感を覚えている。パルミアは被害が少なく、余裕がある方ということで救援も求められたわい。

en: Any help we can give... Palmia has only a small military, though. Zanan and the Yerles have the largest standing armies, and as far as war potential goes... Y-you don't mean!
jp: 余裕があると言っても…。パルミアには最小限の軍事力しかありません。それもザナンやイェルスの駐留部隊が大半で、戦力になりそうなものは…ま、まさか！

en: I do. The continent of Tyris contains many ruins of Nefia. Adventurers come here from all over the world. Palmia will take the responsibility of organizing them and dispatching them to various nations, as well as to Lost Ylva, to attempt to resolve the situation. And of course, we'll be offering money and precious artifacts in exchange for their support.
jp: そのまさかです。ティリス大陸にはネフィアが多く、世界中から冒険者たちが集まってきています。パルミアが彼らを組織し、各国とロストイルヴァに派遣して事態の解決を試みるという方向で会談は終了しました。もちろん見返りとして貴重なアーティファクトや支援金を頂けるよう取り交わしてあります。

en: Erystia, I am entrusting you with coordinating the adventurers. I will be busy with foreign relations.
jp: エリステア、冒険者への対応はおぬしに任せる。わしは対外交渉で忙しくなるだろう。

en: (This is an enormous responsibility... But it might get me closer to the history of the gods.)
jp: （これはまた、なんという大任を…でも神々の歴史に近づく好機だわ）

en: Very well.. I will begin preparations at once.
jp: わかりました。早速、準備を始めます。

en: <Mizuki> The Abyss Princess
jp: 深海の姫『ミヅキ』

en:
A voice suddenly resonates within your mind as you are walking.
Despite your surprise, you listen intently to the faint voice...
jp:
歩いていると不意に、あなたの頭の中に声が響いた。
驚きながらもあなたは、今にも消え入りそうなその声に耳を傾けた…。

en: I'm sure someone out there will be able to hear this. My ancestor that had been slumbering for tens of thousands of years has recently begun to awaken. Because of that, our castle has risen to the surface... The psychic waves emitted by my ancestor have driven the people of the surrounding islands insane. The closer he comes to fully awakening, the further the psychic waves spread. Eventually they will engulf the world.
jp: 感受性の強い者ならきっとこの声を聞き取れるじゃろう。先日、海に眠るわしのご先祖様が数万年ぶりに覚醒しての。それに呼応するかのようにわしらの城は海面へと浮上したんじゃが…ご先祖様の発する精神波に耐えられず、近隣の島の住民は皆発狂してしもうた。目覚めが進行するに伴って、精神波の干渉領域は日々拡大しておる。いずれは世界を丸ごと飲みこむじゃろう。

en: I... I do not wish for such a thing to happen... I have heard that a powerful warrior exists somewhere here on the surface. If anyone hears this, please, convey this message to them. I want you to stop my ancestor. I am ashamed I cannot handle this myself... Please. I have prepared for a tortoise to take you to my castle from the coastal town of Valm...
jp: わしは…こんなこと望んでおらぬ。…地上には強大な力を持つ者がいるという話をかねがね聞いておる。もしこの声が聞こえたのなら、どうかその者達に伝えてほしい。ご先祖様を止めてもらいたいのじゃ。恥ずかしいことにわしにはもう手の打ちようがなくての…。ヴァルムという海沿いの街に、迎えの亀を用意しておる…。

en:
The voice faded in intensity until you could no longer hear it.
You start walking once again, feeling both anxiety and excitement.
jp:
声は小さくなっていき、やがて聞こえなくなった。
あなたは不安と高揚感を覚えながらも再び歩き始めた。

en: <Fron> The Tour Planner
jp: プランナーの『フロン』

en: <Conerly> The Major General of Palmia
jp: パルミア少将『コネリー』

en: <Erystia> The Scholar of History
jp: 歴史を学ぶ『エリステア』

en: - In Palmia Castle's Waiting room -
jp: - パルミア城 応接室 -

en: The negotiations with <Garziem> the Iron Horseman were successful. Using the equipment capable of protecting adventurers from supersonic speeds, a massive reduction in travel time is now possible. By utilizing the transportation hubs in each country that have remained hidden until now, anywhere should be accessible within a day. All of the information is written here, so you should distribute the devices after assessing the aptitude of the adventurers.
jp: 鉄騎のガルジエムとの交渉成功、および冒険者たちの耐加速・耐衝撃能力を考慮に入れた結果、大幅な移動時間短縮が可能になりました。以前から押さえておいた世界各国の交通機関と併せて、本日からでも全経路が使用可能です。経路ごとの詳しい情報はこちらに記載してありますので、あとは冒険者たちの適性を考えて振り分けるとよいでしょう。

en: Hoh... By being able to dispatch adventurers quickly all across the world, we should be able to get the situation under control. I'll try it out right away. I apologize for requesting something this large so suddenly.
jp: なるほど…。これなら世界各地に素早く冒険者たちを派遣し、事態の収拾に当たることができますね。早速試してみましょう。今回はすみません、急にこんな大仕事を頼んでしまって。

en: Please, it was nothing. I'll be heading off. Let me know if there needs to be any changes to the plans.
jp: いえいえ、それほどでも。ああ、プランの修正が必要になりましたら適宜対応いたしますので。それでは失礼します。

en: Erystia... Mmmgh?! W-was that the Tour Planner you requested help from that just ran out of here? The girl has some legs on her, I'll give her that.
jp: エリステ…むうっ！？い、今走り去っていったのが協力を以前要請したというツアープランナーか。なんだあの足の速さは。

en: She literally runs everywhere around the world to make her tour plans. What do you expect? Anyways, how was the meeting with Zanan and the Yerles?
jp: なんでも普段から観光プランを組むために世界中を文字通り駆け巡っているとか。ところで少将、ザナン・イェルスとの会議はいかがでしたか？

en: Ah, well, the armies of Chaos are still running wild. I'm worried that these two countries may fall if the onslaught continues. I think it will be necessary after all to take the Cradle of Chaos on Lost Ylva.
jp: ああ、混沌の軍勢は未だに猛威を振るっておるそうだ。何度退けようとも日が経てばまた空から降りてくるということで２国とも悩んでおる。やはり発生源と思われるロストイルヴァの巨城を攻略する必要があるだろう。

en: But the White Hawk just recently mentioned in a report that it's impossible to continue further into the Cradle of Chaos due to a strong magical boundary, right?
jp: ですが先日巨城から帰還した白き鷹の報告では、強力な結界によって深層に進めなくなっていることでしたよね。

en: Indeed. Supposedly the Yerles have a way to deal with that. They're going to start preparations for it now. Oh yes, and there were two requests from Zanan. The first is the extermination of a biological weapon that accidentally got out of control. You can look at the documents on that later. The second is a personal request from one of the Zanan officers... When the White Hawk reports in again, the officer wants you to hand him this letter.
jp: うむ。それに関してはイェルス側に対抗策があるという。これから準備に着手するそうだ。そうそう、それとザナン側から依頼がふたつあった。ひとつは、事故で暴れ出した危険な生体兵器の殲滅。後でこの資料に目を通しておくように。ふたつめはザナン軍の士官からの個人的な依頼だが…白き鷹がおぬしを訪れた時に、この手紙を渡してほしいということだった。

en: I'll deal with both of them. Well, the first one will be dangerous, so we'll need an adventurer. I'll think about it and send someone suitable. The latter really is just personal business, but I don't mind if its just handing over a letter.
jp: どちらもザナンで対応してもらいたい内容ですね。まぁ、前者は冒険者でないと殲滅困難なほど危険ということでしょう。適性を考えて冒険者を割り振ります。後者は本当に個人的ですね。手紙を渡すだけなら別に構いませんが。

en: (*Sigh*... Things are going to become even busier. Looks like I won't be getting any sleep tonight.)
jp: （はぁ…これから本当に忙しくなるわ。今夜は眠れないな…）

en: <Liana> The Girl of Fancies
jp: 妄想少女『リアナ』

en: <Larnneire> The Listener of the Wind
jp: 風を聴く者『ラーネイレ』

en: <Lomias> The Messenger From Vindale
jp: 異形の森の使者『ロミアス』

en: <Halion> The Extremist
jp: 過激派の『ハリオン』

en: You're finally back. Did you manage to find out anything?
it: Finalmente sei tornata, Liana. Sei riuscita a sapere qualcosa?
jp: ようやく戻ってきたかリアナ。情報収集は上手くいったのか？

en: I heard from a passing adventurer that it's recently become possible to travel back and forth between North Tyris and the floating continent from some mountain. The airships of the Eulderna capital all appear to be out in combat with the demons or patrolling. I think we should head for North Tyris.
it: L'ho sentito da un avventuriero di passaggio: pare che da poco si possa andare avanti e indietro fra una montagna di Tyris del Nord e il continente fluttuante. La capitale di Eulderna è in stato d'allerta per gli scontri con i mostri, e per giunta le aeronavi sono tutte fuori. Cambiamo destinazione: andiamo a Tyris del Nord.
jp: 通りかかった冒険者から聞いたんだけど、最近になってノースティリスの山と浮遊大陸を行き来できるようになったらしいの。エウダーナ王都は魔物との戦闘で警戒体制にある上、飛行船も出払っているみたい。行先をノースティリスに変更しましょう。

en: What? We came all the way out here for nothing? Who was it again? The one saying that Bethel just HAS to be on the floating continent, so we should take one of Eulderna's airships?
it: Come? Siamo venuti fin quaggiù e non ce n'era alcun bisogno, allora. E chi era che strepitava che Bethel doveva per forza trovarsi sul continente fluttuante, e che dovevamo imbarcarci su un'aeronave di Eulderna?
jp: なんだと。ここまで来たというのに、その必要などなかったわけか。一体誰だ？ヴェセルがいるのは浮遊大陸に違いない、だからエウダーナの飛行船に乗りこもうと騒いでいたのは。

en: What other choice did we have?! At the time we left, that was the only way that seemed feasible! I want to get to Bethel as soon as I can! Oh Bethel, we'll just be a little longer... By the way, where is Larnneire? Is she not back from gathering food?
it: Quando siamo partiti non c'era altro modo, che ci potevo fare! Anch'io voglio rivedere Bethel il prima possibile! Ah, Bethel, aspettami ancora un po', Bethel... A proposito, e Larnneire? Non è ancora tornata dalle provviste?
jp: 出発時点ではそれしか手段がなかったんだからしょうがないじゃない！あたしだって一刻も早くヴェセルに会いたいのに！ああヴェセル、もう少し待っていてねヴェセル…ところでラーネイレは？まだ食料調達から戻っていないの？

en: Not yet... Well, speak of the devil. Here she comes.
it: Non ancora... anzi, a parlare del diavolo. Eccola che torna proprio adesso.
jp: まだだが…いや、噂をすればなんとやらだな。ちょうど戻ってきたようだ。

en: Lomias! Liana! Good, I need your help.
it: Lomias! Liana! Meno male, datemi una mano tutti e due.
jp: ロミアス！リアナ！よかった、二人とも少し手伝って。

en: Uugh...
it: Uuh...
jp: うう…。

en: Larnneire. I know you said you'd get food, but don't you think human flesh is going a bit far?
it: Larnneire. Avevi detto che andavi a procurare da mangiare, ma la carne umana mi pare di pessimo gusto, non trovi?
jp: ラーネイレ。食料を調達してくるとは言っていたが、いくらなんでも人肉は趣味が悪いんじゃないか？

en: This isn't a time for jokes. Hurry up and clear that spot for me.
it: Non è il momento di scherzare. Sbrigati a liberare quel posto.
jp: 冗談を言っている場合じゃないの。早くそこを片づけて。

en: Good grief. You should have just left him... This is just like when you picked up that adventurer after that storm.
it: Ma guarda, e bastava lasciarlo dov'era... Come il giorno della tempesta, di nuovo a raccogliere gente stramazzata per strada.
jp: やれやれ、放っておけばいいものを…。あの嵐の日のように、また行き倒れを拾うとは。

en: Fufu, that reminds me of the day I met Bethel... Huh? Hey, doesn't this guy look familiar?
it: Fufu, mi torna in mente il giorno in cui incontrai Bethel... Uh? Voi due, non vi sembra di averlo già visto da qualche parte?
jp: ふふ、思い出すわ…あたしがヴェセルと出会ったあの日のことを。…あら？二人とも、この人ちょっと見覚えない？

en: Hey hey, cut it out! I don't know any piece of trash like this!
it: Ehi, ehi, scherzi? Uno straccio ridotto così io non l'ho mai visto.
jp: おいおい、冗談だろう！こんなボロ雑巾、私は知らないぞ。

en: It doesn't matter who it is. I can't abandon someone that's injured. Now let's hurry up and treat him.
it: Chiunque sia, non importa. Non si abbandona un ferito. Sbrighiamoci a medicarlo.
jp: 誰だって構わないわ。傷ついた人を見捨てるわけにはいかないの。早く手当をしましょう。

en: <Liana> The Girl of Fancies
jp: 妄想少女『リアナ』

en: <Larnneire> The Listener of the Wind
jp: 風を聴く者『ラーネイレ』

en: <Lomias> The Messenger From Vindale
jp: 異形の森の使者『ロミアス』

en: <Halion> The Extremist
jp: 過激派の『ハリオン』

en: Where am I..? Ah, t-the demon!? It's not...  It's not here. Thank god. Ahh... Those two are... Elea?
it: Dove sono...? Ah, il demone!? Il demone... pare non ci sia. Meno male. Ah... E quei due là sono... Elea?
jp: ここは…？ハッ、あの悪魔は！？悪魔は…いないようだな…。よかった。ああ…。そこの二人はエレア…か？

en: Hah... Have you finally regained consciousness? I was beginning to worry that nursing you would bring our urgent travels to a halt... Hmm? I get the feeling I've said this before.
it: Ah... finalmente hai ripreso conoscenza. Cominciavo a chiedermi per quanto ancora il nostro viaggio, che ha una certa urgenza, sarebbe rimasto sospeso ad aspettare che ti riprendessi... Uhm? Una cosa simile l'ho già detta, tempo fa.
jp: はぁ…意識がようやく戻ったのか…。 君の回復を待つために、我々の急を要する旅がいつまで中断されるのか、気を揉んで…ん？昔もこんなことを言ったな。

en: I'm glad you seem to be okay. When I first saw you, I thought it might already be too late. I found you with serious injuries next to the river. It's fortunate that someone like us with healing abilities found you before night fell.
it: Sono contenta che tu abbia ripreso conoscenza. Quando ti ho visto la prima volta ho creduto che fosse ormai troppo tardi. Eri in fin di vita sulla riva del fiume. Sei stato fortunato che a trovarti, prima che il buio coprisse ogni cosa, siamo stati noi, che abbiamo il dono di guarire.
jp: 無事に意識が戻ってよかったわ。あなたを最初に見たときは、もう手遅れかと思ったほどだもの。あなたは重傷を負い川辺に倒れていたわ。宵闇が辺りを覆う前に、癒し手の力を持つ私たちに発見されたのは幸運だったわね。

en: Oh, he's awake... You really do look familiar. I wonder where I saw you before.
it: Oh, ti sei svegliato. ...Lo sapevo, questa faccia l'ho già vista. Dove ci saremo incontrati?
jp: あら、目が覚めたの。…やっぱり見覚えがあるわ。どこで会ったのかしら。

en: Got your strength back? We should continue our journey... No, hold on. Before we resume our travels after this unnecessary aid, do you mind telling us about the life in this land?
it: Il corpo regge, ormai? Noi riprendiamo il viaggio... no, aspetta. Se non è un'ingerenza, prima di ripartire vuoi che ti insegni qualche accorgimento per vivere da queste parti?
jp: もう身体は大丈夫だな？我々は旅を再開…いや待てよ。余計な世話でなければ我々が旅を再開する前に、この土地での生活の知恵を授けようか？

en: Cut it out, Lomias.
it: Piantala, Lomias.
jp: ちょっとやめなさいロミアス。

en: I'm sorry for causing you trouble. My name is Hali... Harry. I've been visiting Elean villages looking for a friend, but after being attacked by a demon, fell into the river and got carried away by the current.
it: A quanto pare vi ho dato disturbo, mi dispiace. Il mio nome è Hali... Harry. Cerco un amico e per questo giro i villaggi degli Elea di ogni terra; sono stato assalito da un mostro e, mentre fuggivo, sono caduto nel fiume e la corrente mi ha travolto.
jp: どうも迷惑をかけたようだな、すまない。俺の名前はハリ…。ハーリーだ。友人を探して各地のエレア集落を訪れているのだが、魔物に襲われて逃げる際に、川に転落し激流に呑まれてしまった。

en: (I gave them a false name without even thinking about it. Was it too suspicious?)
it: (Mi è scappato un nome falso senza nemmeno pensarci: sarà stato troppo poco credibile?)
jp: （思わず偽名を名乗ってしまったが嘘くさすぎただろうか？）

en: Harry...? Ah. Hmm...
it: Hali...? Ah. Ma guarda...
jp: ハリ…？あっ。へぇ…。

en: I'm Larnneire. We're on a trip looking for our friend as well. We just found out about a hitch in our original plan and have changed our destination. I hope we both find the people we are searching for.
it: Io sono Larnneire. Anche noi siamo in viaggio in cerca di un amico. I piani sono andati un po' storti e abbiamo dovuto cambiare destinazione, però. Speriamo di trovarle tutti e due, le persone che cerchiamo.
jp: 私はラーネイレ。私達も友人を探して旅をしているところなの。ちょっと予定が狂って目的地を変更することになってしまったけれど。お互い、探し人が見つかるといいわね。

en: Harry - or whatever your name is - I've got a bit of bad news. From what I've heard, there's an Elean village in Niesa past the Southwest mountains. However, a demon of vengeance has been attacking the towns of Niesa recently, and chaos spirits have become more active as well. If you're going to head for that village, you'll have to be very careful.
it: Harry, hai detto? Anche tu ne hai passate. Da quel che ho sentito, oltre la montagna a sud-ovest c'è un villaggio di Elea in Niesa. Ma di questi tempi una cosa che chiamano il demone della vendetta assale le città di Niesa, e anche gli spiriti del caos si sono fatti più attivi. Se vuoi raggiungere il villaggio, sta' bene attento a non farti assalire.
jp: ハーリーと言ったか、お前も大変だな。聞いたところによると、南西に一つ山を越えたところにニーサのエレア集落があるという話だ。最近は復讐の悪魔とかいうものがニーサの町々を襲っており、混沌の精霊どもも活発化しているそうだ。集落を目指すのならせいぜい襲われないように気をつけることだな。

en: I'm sure it will be tough, but do your best. No matter what happened in the past, everyone has to keep moving forward.
it: Ne avrai passate di tutti i colori, ma insomma, tieni duro. Qualunque sia il passato di un uomo, bisogna superarlo e andare avanti.
jp: 色々とあったんだろうけど、まぁ、頑張りなさい。人はどんな過去だろうと乗り越えて、前に進まなきゃいけないのだから。

en: Thank you all. I'd love to give you something to show my gratitude, but unfortunately I lost everything in the river...
it: Vi devo davvero molto. Vorrei sdebitarmi in qualche modo, ma la corrente si è portata via tutto quello che avevo e non ho niente con me...
jp: 今回は本当に世話になった。何か礼をしたいところだが、あいにく激流に所持品を流されて何も持ち合わせていない…。

en: We just did what anyone should do. There's no need for thanks... Ah. When our journeys are over. we should meet again in Vindale. I'd be happy to have more people assist with the revival of the Forest.
it: Abbiamo fatto solo ciò che si doveva, non c'è niente da ringraziare... Anzi, sai. Quando i nostri viaggi saranno finiti, rivediamoci a Vindale. Da Elea a Elea, mi farebbe piacere se ci aiutassi a far rinascere la foresta.
jp: 私たちは当然のことをしたまでよ、お礼なんて…。そうね。旅が終わったら、ヴィンデールでまた会いましょう。同じエレアとして、森の復興を手伝ってもらえると嬉しいわ。

en: Yeah. If I return to Vindale, I'd love to help...
it: Sì. Se mai potrò tornare a Vindale, non sarebbe male...
jp: ああ。俺がヴィンデールに戻れたなら、それもいいな…。

en: <Barius> The Blue Haired
jp: 青い髪の『ヴァリウス』

en: <Orphe> The Apostle of Chaos
jp: 混沌の使徒『オルフェ』

en: <Alfred> the Cangnan Wind of Lothria
jp: ロスリアの蒼風『アルフレド』

en: <Minea> The Puppeteer
jp: 人形使い『ミネア』

en: - At the same time, in Barius' private room. -
it: Alla stessa ora - la stanza privata di Barius -
jp: 同刻 - ヴァリウスの私室 -

en: Yo.
it: Ehilà.
jp: やぁ。

en: Dropping in unexpected as always... So what do you want?
it: Compare e sparisce come sempre, lei. ...Che cosa vuole?
jp: 相変わらず神出鬼没ですね。…何の用です。

en: You're so cold. The adventurers give a much better reaction than that. Whatever. Where this world is being led to still remains unclear, but everything has gone as you planned so far. But... "His" destiny - death - has been decided.
it: Che freddezza. Gli avventurieri mi rispondono molto meglio, sai. Vabbè. Dove sia diretto questo mondo resta ancora poco chiaro, ma fin qui le cose sono andate più o meno secondo i tuoi piani. Però... il destino di morte di <lui> è ormai fissato.
jp: 冷たいなぁ、冒険者はもっといいリアクションをしてくれるよ。まぁいいや。この世界が導かれる先はまだ不明瞭なままだけれど、ここまではなんとか君の予定通りに行っているね。でもね…「彼」の死の運命が確定してしまったんだ。

en: ...I see.
it: ...Ah. Capisco.
jp: …。そう、ですか。

en: Ah, even I had hoped that this could be avoided of course. But the butterfly effect affects so much, and given the current state, it's already past the point of changing.
it: Sì, certo, anch'io speravo che il destino deviasse in qualche modo. Ma l'effetto farfalla ha agito su un altro bersaglio, e ormai, per come stanno i fattori in gioco, non c'è più niente da fare.
jp: ああ、もちろんボクだってどうにか運命から逸れることを期待したんだけれど。バタフライエフェクトも別対象に作用しちゃったし、もう因子からしてどうにもならないんだ。

en: He was prepared. We knew some things would have to be sacrificed for our plans. And it's so empowering to die for the success of your ideals, isn't it?
it: Anche lui lo aveva messo in conto. Per realizzare il piano serve un prezzo. E piuttosto che accettare la rovina, morire per un ideale.
jp: 彼も覚悟の上でした。計画の実現のためには代償が必要になる。そして滅びを享受するくらいならば理想のために死ぬ、と。

en: Die for your ideals, huh. I never will understand you mortals.
it: Morire per un ideale, addirittura. Lo penso ogni volta: voi mortali siete davvero incomprensibili.
jp: 理想のために死ぬだなんて。いつも思うけれど、君たち定命は本当にわけがわからないよ。

en: ...You have work to do as well, don't you? You should get back to it quickly.
it: ...Non ha un lavoro suo, lei? Farebbe meglio a tornarci subito.
jp: …あなたにも自分の仕事があるのでは？早くそちらに戻ってはいかがです。

en: Ehhh... You really are cold! Fine then. I'll leave for now.
it: Uuh... sei proprio freddo, tu! E va bene, per oggi me ne torno.
jp: ひえー…本当に君は冷たいなぁ！じゃあ今日はこれで帰るとするよ。
ぐっ…！？あ…あ…。

en: Oh my. You suddenly looked like you were in pain. Are you okay?
it: Oh, poverino. Ti sei messo a star male all'improvviso: stai bene?
jp: あら、いやだ。急に苦しみだしたけれど大丈夫なの？

en: Ugh... I-'m fine. It's just... my disease.
it: U... sto bene, non c'è problema. Ma no... è solo un vecchio malanno.
jp: う…大丈夫、問題ありません。なに…ちょっとした持病ですよ。

en: Ohh, just like a mortal! So fragile! Understand that our duty isn't finished until all the followers are released. If you become a hindrance then we'll toss you aside.
it: Oh, ecco un mortale coi fiocchi! Che corpo fragile vi ritrovate! L'avrai capito, ma nel momento in cui tutti i figli del caos saranno liberati il tuo compito sarà finito. Se diventi un peso, aspettati di essere lasciato indietro.
jp: おお、さすがは定命！随分とまぁ、脆い身体をしているものだ！理解はしているだろうが、全ての眷属を解放した時点でお前の役目は終わっている。足手まといになるようなら捨て置かれると思え。

en: No no, I made it this far. I'll make it to the end...
it: Ma no, ma no: sono arrivato fin qui. Vi accompagnerò fino alla fine...
jp: いえいえ、ここまで来たのです。最後までご一緒しますよ…。

en: (I took more of the "medicine" than usual... The damage is worse than I expected. Is it almost time...?)
it: (Di <medicina> ne ho portata in abbondanza... ma il danno è più grave del previsto. Sarà il momento di agire...?)
jp: （「薬」は多めに持ってきましたが…想定よりもダメージが大きい。仕掛ける頃合か…？）

en: <Orphe> The Apostle of Chaos
jp: 混沌の使徒『オルフェ』

en: <Alfred> the Cangnan Wind of Lothria
jp: ロスリアの蒼風『アルフレド』

en: <Minea> The Puppeteer
jp: 人形使い『ミネア』

en: <Minea> The Puppeteer
jp: 人形使い『ミネア』

en: This last Servant is quite the problem, isn't it? Even after we freed it, it simply bound itself to the ruin of Nefia instead of going to work. I mean, I know it's supposed to be the demon of binding, but I didn't except it to bind itself.
it: L'ultimo dei figli del caos ci ha dato del filo da torcere, però. Liberarlo è stato facile, ma poi si è legato da solo a una Nefia e non si è più mosso. Sarà pure il demone dei vincoli, ma non avrei mai pensato che finisse per vincolare sé stesso.
jp: それにしても最後の眷属には困りましたね。解放したのはいいものの、まさか自身をネフィアに縛りつけて動こうとしなかったのですから。いくら束縛の悪魔とはいえ、自分で自分を束縛するとは思いませんでしたよ。

en: Isn't it just your powers of awakening being weak because of your poor health?
it: Se non sei riuscito a mandarlo nel mondo di sotto non sarà che stavi male e la tua capacità di trasferimento si era indebolita?
jp: 下界に送れなかったのは貴方の体調が悪くて、転送能力が弱まっていたからではなくて？

en: No. I've already recovered from that. I'm certain it has something to do with that Servant. I wasn't expecting that either, though. If Master Orphe hadn't suppressed it, we would have been bound ourselves wouldn't we?
it: No. Da allora la salute si è rimessa. Se non sono riuscito a mandarlo giù è per il potere di quel figlio del caos. Anch'io non me l'aspettavo affatto. Se il signor Orphe non lo avesse fermato, saremmo finiti legati anche noi, no?
jp: いえ。体調はあれから落ち着いています。送れなかったのはあの眷属の能力によるものでしょう。私も完全に予想外でしたよ。オルフェ様が止めなければ我々も縛りつけられる寸前だったではないですか。

en: Master Orphe? Is something bothering you?
it: Signor Orphe? Da un po' ha un'aria strana.
jp: オルフェ様？先ほどからご様子がおかしいようですが。

en: ...! That vision... What was I looking at...?
it: ...! Che cos'era quella visione... Che cosa stavo guardando...?
jp: …！なんだ今のビジョンは…。私は何を見ていた…？

en: Oh, oh. Are you ill?
it: Oh, oh. Non si sente bene, per caso?
jp: おやおや。もしや具合が悪いのですか？

en: ...I'm going to walk around a little. You wait here.
it: ...Vado a fare due passi qui intorno. Voi restate qui ad aspettare.
jp: …少し辺りを歩いてくる。お前たちはここで待機していろ。

en: I wonder what happened to Master Orphe. He seemed confused about something...
it: Che cosa sarà successo al signor Orphe? Sembrava confuso per qualcosa...
jp: オルフェ様は一体どうしたのかしら。なにか混乱しているみたいだったわ…。

en: We're closing in on the Eternal Seal. As an Apostle, perhaps he was influenced by being so close to his god.
it: Il Sigillo Eterno è ormai vicino. Essersi accostato al dio del caos potrebbe avere qualche effetto su di lui, che ne è l'apostolo.
jp: 神の間も近いですからね。混沌の神に近づいたことで、使徒として何かしらの影響を受けているのかもしれません。

en: Ah, I see... Huh? I think this is the first time we've been able to speak alone. There's always been the three of us since you joined.
it: Capisco... Uh? Mi pare sia la prima volta che parliamo noi due soli. Da quando ti sei unito a noi ci siamo sempre mossi in tre.
jp: なるほど…あら？貴方と二人きりで話す機会は初めてのような気がするわ。貴方が合流してからはずっと三人で行動していたもの。

en: You know, you're right. I've never gotten the chance to ask why you're aiming for the Eternal Seal alongside Master Orphe. But I'd like to understand your circumstances, as a like-minded comrade.
it: È proprio vero. Ora che ci penso, non le ho mai chiesto perché punti al Sigillo Eterno insieme al signor Orphe. Non che dubiti che siamo dalla stessa parte: mi domandavo solo come sia andata.
jp: 確かにそうですね。そういえばあなたがオルフェ様と共に神の間を目指す理由を訊いたことがありませんでした。いえ、同志なのは理解しているつもりですが。どういったいきさつがあったのやらと。

en: Fair enough. I'm from House Bellum in Eulderna. I was driven out.
it: Non gliel'avevo detto. Vengo da casa Bellum, di Eulderna. Anche se poi mi hanno cacciata.
jp: 話していなかったわね。私はエウダーナのベルム家出身なの。追い出されてしまったけれどね。

en: House Bellum. Ah, even an ignorant man like me knows that name. If I'm not mistaken, they're a distinguished family of wizards... Why were you driven out?
it: Casa Bellum. Ah, il nome l'ho sentito perfino io, che sono un ignorante. Una famiglia illustre di maghi, se non sbaglio... Perché l'hanno cacciata?
jp: ベルム家。ああ、無知な私でも名前は聞いたことがあります。確か魔術の名門だったはず…。なぜ追い出されてしまったのですか？

en: Indeed they are. I developed a type of magic to manipulate humans, but it was never recognized as official magic. The examiner found it difficult, and proclaimed it to be a complete bastardization of domination magic. That's despite the fact that the magical structure is completely different. Even my younger sister could realize its superior potential.
it: Già. Tutto è cominciato quando la magia per manovrare le persone che avevo ideato non è stata riconosciuta come magia ufficiale. L'esaminatore se ne uscì dicendo che era difficile da controllare e che era una copia scadente della magia del dominio. Eppure la struttura magica è tutt'altra cosa, ed è più versatile: lo capiva perfino la più piccola delle mie sorelle.
jp: そうね。私の編み出した人繰りの魔法が、正式魔法に認定されなかったのが始まりだったわ。審査官が、制御が難しい上に支配の魔法の完全劣化だとか言い出してね。魔術構造的には全くの別物であって、応用性にも優れることくらい私の末の妹でも理解していたわ。

en: I found it strange that he couldn't recognize it, seeing as he was a senior wizard that had once been quite cozy with the Court. I did keep requesting re-examination, of course. But this continued many times, and soon people began to call me the shame of House Bellum. Nasty and untrue rumors began to spread. My parents, worried about appearances, severed their ties with me. I just...! This kind of rotten world...!
it: Mi pareva che ci fosse qualcosa di storto, e infatti un mago di rango che tempo prima mi aveva corteggiata era in combutta con l'esaminatore. Naturalmente continuai a chiedere una nuova valutazione. Ma a furia di insistere, a un certo punto tutti presero a chiamarmi la vergogna di casa Bellum. Quando me ne accorsi giravano già voci senza fondamento, e non si sapeva chi le avesse messe in giro. I miei genitori, per il buon nome, mi ripudiarono. Io...! Io un mondo così ingiusto...!
jp: 何かおかしいと思ったら、昔言い寄ってきたある上級魔導士が審査官と癒着していたの。当然私は再審査を要求し続けたわ。でも何度も続けているうちに、いつしか世間は私をベルム家の恥呼ばわりするようになっていた。気が付いた時には、"誰が流したのかわからない"根も葉もない噂も流れていたわ。両親は世間体を気にして私を絶縁したの。私は！私はこんな理不尽な世界っ…！

en: ...This is a long story, isn't it? Here, I've made some tea. Have a drink.
it: ...Sarà una storia lunga. Ho preparato del tè. Continuiamo a parlare mentre lo beviamo.
jp: …長くなりそうですね。紅茶を淹れました。飲みながら話しましょう。

en: Oh. What was this made with?
it: Oh, e questo?
jp: あら、これは？

en: It's made using precious tea leaves from Lothria. I've put in a little extra sugar for you, since it's the style in Lothria to drink it all in one gulp.
it: Ho usato foglie di tè di Lothria che tenevo da parte. Alla maniera di Lothria si mette molto zucchero e si beve tutto d'un fiato, prima che si raffreddi.
jp: とっておきのロスリアの茶葉を使いました。砂糖を多めに入れて、冷めないうちに一飲みにするのがロスリア流です。

en: I'll try it... So sweet! The sugar didn't finish dissolving though, so it was a bit coarse. Let's see. Right, after being thrown out with no place to go, I became an adventurer. With my "disappointing" magic, I didn't have any problems making money. I roamed about all over the world. But no matter how famous I became, I wasn't satisfied.
it: Lo assaggio volentieri. ...Dolce!! Lo zucchero non si è sciolto del tutto, si sente sotto i denti. Dunque, dicevo. Ecco, dopo che mi cacciarono non avevo dove andare e mi feci avventuriera. Delusa com'ero, mi guadagnavo il viaggio con la magia e vagavo di terra in terra. Per quanta fama mettessi insieme, non mi bastava mai.
jp: 頂くわ。…甘い！！砂糖が溶けきってなくてざらざらするわ。ええと。そう、追い出された後行くあてもなかった私は冒険者になったの。失意のまま魔法を駆使して路銀を稼いで、各地を放浪していたわ。いくら名声を上げても、全く満たされなかった。

en: You have my sympathy.
it: La compatisco.
jp: 同情しますよ。

en: Then one day, I found myself wrapped in light and brought to Lost Ylva... Ugh... Keh... Wh... What is this!
it: E poi venne quel giorno. Fui avvolta da una luce e mi ritrovai in questa Irva Perduta... ugh... agh... che... che cos'è questo!
jp: そんなある日よ。光に包まれてこのロストイルヴァ…うぐっ…あがが…な…にこれは！

en: I truly do pity you. If you hadn't been possessed by Chaos, this never would have happened.
it: La compatisco davvero. Se il caos non l'avesse ammaliata, non sarebbe finita così.
jp: 本当に同情しますよ。混沌に魅入られなければ、こんなことにならなかったのに。

en: U...Ugh... Gah...
it: Gh... gh... gheeh. Ge... ah.
jp: が…が…ぐええっ。げ…ああ。

en: Since your magic might be a hindrance when I go to take care of "him", I've been waiting for my chance to act. You also planned to use your persuasion, didn't you? Since I'd find it troubling to throw the world into a crisis over a personal grudge, I put Ether powder in that tea. "High Purity" Ether that was found in South Tyris, at that.
it: Quando sarà il momento di farlo fuori la sua magia mi darebbe fastidio, così aspettavo che ci separassimo dagli altri. A seconda dei casi avevo messo in conto anche di convincerla, sa? Non posso lasciare che il mondo finisca in pericolo per un rancore personale, e così mi sono permesso di mettere nel tè della polvere d'etere. E per giunta polvere di quei cristalli purissimi che dicono siano stati trovati in Tyris del Sud.
jp: 奴を始末する際にあなたの魔法は邪魔になるので、別行動する時を待っていたのです。場合によっては説得も視野に入れていましたよ？私怨で世界を危機に陥れられては困りますし、紅茶にエーテルの粉末を入れさせていただきました。それもサウスティリスで見つかったという高純度結晶の粉末をね。

en: Ah... But I suppose you can't even understand me anymore, can you?
it: Ah, a vederla così... non capisce più le parole degli uomini, ormai.
jp: ああ、その様子では…もう人の言葉は理解できませんか。
